brief:
Mint a lane's documents and run records as a content-addressed evidence bundle (one record per leaf, a ledger, recomputable checks, a run root with a Merkle root and a second hash axis) and re-derive it from the root with two independent verifiers. Use when a research lane, a solver lane or a document pipeline needs its work to travel as addresses that a stranger re-derives, when a chronicle should become a leaf of the next step, when a label or a leaf changes and the question is "re-mint or overwrite", or when a note must quote a root it cannot retype. Encodes the leaves file, the step discipline, the two-verifier rule, the two-roots-not-one-overwrite rule and the gotchas the lane recorded.

A measurement, a document or a run leaves the room as a decimal in a note. The decimal travels; nothing binds it to the bytes it came from. This method gives the bytes an address and gives the lane a root, so that whatever is quoted later can be re-derived by whoever holds the bundle, and whoever holds only the root can tell whether a bundle is the one that was cited.
